profile_text.body:
Cerence Inc. is a public company headquartered in Burlington, Massachusetts, trading under the ticker CRNC. According to its own site, it provides conversational and agentic AI-powered user experiences for automotive and beyond, describing itself as the trusted interaction and action layer for physical AI. Its platform combines voice, multimodal understanding, contextual intelligence, agentic architecture, and governed execution, aimed at helping people communicate with vehicles, machines, and intelligent systems. The company says its technology has been developed and deployed at automotive scale, and that leading automakers, technology companies, and enterprises worldwide rely on it.

Named offerings on the site include Cerence xUI, which the company describes as a multimodal AI foundation letting OEMs combine speech, vision, and vehicle data to understand driver intent, and Cerence Emergency Vehicle Detection (EVD), which uses audio AI to detect and localize more than 1,500 emergency sirens across nearly 50 countries. The site states EVD can identify approaching emergency vehicles from more than 300 meters away with interior microphones and beyond 800 meters with exterior microphones. The site also describes work with Microsoft on Zero Trust and layered AI security for in-car assistants, and cites third quarter results with revenue up 12% YoY, connected services revenue up 20% YoY, and operating cash flow of $20M supporting a first-ever share repurchase program. The site names Timo Matheja and Stefan Hamerich in connection with a demonstration of speech signal enhancement for multi-seat in-car environments.

The company's profile lists it as a for-profit public company with CIK 0001768267. No lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded for it.
